text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... whew.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (The Takarazuka Kinen... It's almost time.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Crown-san and Kita-san are both running... No, but I've trained properly too—!)

text_block_list.name: Boy with a Hat
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Boy with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
It's Cheval Grand! I knew it!
Waaaah, it's the real dealã¼ã¼!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? Umm...!?

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh dear! I'm so sorry, right in the middle of training!
Come on now, stop getting in the way.

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry about that.
She's just a huge fan of yours.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... M-Mine...?

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ever since watching the last Tenno Sho (Spring),
she's completely hooked! Even with the hat, she wouldn't
stop begging to wear one just like yours.

text_block_list.name: Boy with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! This ribbon's color, you know,
is light blue! Hehe, it's the exact same!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
I-It's true...

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's great.
...Ah, I've ended up truly intruding!
Excuse me, I'll be cheering for you in your next race as well.

text_block_list.name: Boy with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Hey Chevalier, you're gonna win the Takarazuka too, right?
You will, right! I'll be watching!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, wait, y-yes...
Ah—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Fans. My—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Mine...? My...
M-Mine...?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Cheval~! Good work today!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hyoe...

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Solo training? Super impressive.
I've thought this for a while, but man, your work ethic is insane~.

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Totally.
We're gonna go cheer for you, so do your best.
Can't wait to see you win!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Y-You're coming to watch me?
All the way to Hanshin... just for that?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"A bullet trip is decided, piece of cake.
Besides, Cheval becoming a Grand Prix champ's gotta be hype, right? No way I'm missing that."

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, for real though.
I actually really like the way you run, Cheval.
You hang in there right down to the very wire, right?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Like, it's downright gritty, y'know?
Not trying to act cool is what makes it so cool.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh... ah... aah--

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Th-Th-Thank you... Well then—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Waaaaaaaaah!!
Wah, wah, waaaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That scared me, that scared me so much!
W-What was that?! What is going on?!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (S-So much has changed...! I don't... I don't know what's going on anymore, but...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (So much that... it makes no sense at all—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm... so happy.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Someone... is watching over me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Someone... is cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Me... for someone like me—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: They're... acknowledging me...!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, I have handed it over safely♪
I'll be counting on you.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bow to Tazuna-san as she leaves,
then look at the package I received—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I gaze upon the numerous boxes packed tightly with envelopes, postcards, and gifts.
choice_data_list: Better get to organizing with gusto...!
Gotta put my back into tidying up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I rolled up my sleeves—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Hello, Trai—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa!?
Wh-What's with all this luggage...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cheval Grand looks surprised. Feeling a swell of pride, I can't help but smile as I gesture toward the pile of boxes.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...A-... Amazing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I read, and read...
there's so much I could never finish it all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's telling me...
that they're rooting for me, that they believe in me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Today was... supposed to be
my day off from training, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I knew it!
Please, let... let me do something!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want... to train.
Much, much more than before.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I want to live up to it.
Both your cheers, and your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want to be strong enough... to live up to everyone's hopes...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Because... because everyone finally acknowledged me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want to be someone who can earn your recognition...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The training menu had already been set on the stricter side in preparation for the culmination of the spring season. However, seeing my Umamusume showing this much motivation...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On my pride as a Trainer, I will put together
a training menu that pushes her to the absolute limit
while still taking proper care of her!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...!
I'll follow you with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can properly live up to
everyone's expectations at the Takarazuka Kinen..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: So that I will never, ever... betray them.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-In that case...! I'll go change right away and head to the track!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh, alright...!

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: ! Huh, what was that just now...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Cheval's giving it her all today too, I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Shine Praise.
So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Wah, P-President... Good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence. Shall we head over
to the Director's office together, then?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —To talk about you.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...I'm looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Hyaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Cheval Grand and I spent our days pushing ourselves to the limit for the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Under overcast skies, this year's
Takarazuka Kinen is underway.
Following yesterday's rain, the turf
has been reported as yielding.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"How will the Umamusume handle this heavy track?
Let us take a look at the paddock now—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH!! Kitasan Black,
put on another massive festival for us todayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your support!!
Even though the weather's unfortunate—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
An excitement big enough to blow the clouds away!
I'll make sure to bring it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Crowwwwn-saaan!!
We're looking forward to your cool, clever running~!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much! In the Takarazuka Kinen,
every girl is a powerhouse worthy of carrying the
fans' expectations, but—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I have no intention of losing!
I will seize the crown with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Kita-san... Crown-san...
They're both getting so much support...
And they're really living up to it.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (B-But... even I—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Here he is, Cheval-kuuuun!!
I've been waiting for your entrance!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text:
All right!!
Go reel in another big victory today, just like that!!

text_block_list.name: Boy with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Chevaaaalã¼ã¼!!
Do your beã¼ã¼ã¼stã¼ã¼!!" his/her},
{"id": 12, "en": "Shuuu-piii~, fushuu-ru-ru-ruuu~~...âª

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Y-yes... I'll do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Even I have fans.
People who acknowledge me... and cheer me on...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Win this, Cheval!!
Don't lose to Kitasan or Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Show us what it takes
to become a Grand Prix Umamusume————!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I want to answer their hopes. I have to...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I don't want to... let them down—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'll... do my best.
I'll do my best, I promise...!!"
